name: pr-standard-reviewer
description: Reviews GitHub pull requests against your own coding standards. Pick a repo, select one or many open PRs, and get a prioritized findings report that references the exact section of your standards docs, explains why each finding matters, and tells you how to fix it. Findings are driven by a knowledge base and review skills you upload and edit inside the app, and you can push the results back as a PR comment.
author: khoaknd
highlights: Pick a repo and batch-review many open PRs at once
Findings ranked by priority: must-fix, should-fix, nice-to-have
Every finding references the exact section of your standards docs
Review logic driven by a knowledge base and skills you upload and edit in-app
Push the review back to the pull request as a comment when you are ready
useCases: Enforce a team coding standard on every pull request before merge
Triage a backlog of open PRs by reviewing several at once and sorting by priority
configuration: Make sure the gateway host has an authenticated GitHub CLI (run: gh auth login)
Open PR Standard Reviewer, add a repo, then upload your standards docs under Knowledge Base
Select one or more open pull requests and click Review
